{{Top|leg}}
A '''Target Permit''' was a permit required by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to hunt a specific target. A Target Permit generally cost between 10 and 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per month depending on the individual's [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]]. The average cost was around 100 credits.
